subject: CFG-1076: which environment drifted on a uniform key
body:
Hello -- Daniel Ortega, security. Please audit the catalog-api configs for
drift: find the environment whose copy sets a must-be-uniform key differently
from the rest, and name the key.

config/POLICY.md lists which keys may differ between environments; only a key
outside that list counts as drift. Leave the two security keys to the separate
security check.

Regards, Daniel Ortega -- security
